component.name: Magpie
component.summary: Bring videos home from the web

description.p: Magpie downloads video and audio from the web. Paste a link, choose a quality, and the file lands in your Downloads folder with a record of where it came from.

ul.li: Quality presets that reach past 360p, merging separate video and audio streams the way modern sites serve them
Audio-only downloads, kept in their original format or converted to MP3 or M4A
Playlists and channels, with a list of items to pick from and a folder of their own
A queue that survives closing the window, and resumes a part-finished download rather than starting it again
Pause, resume, cancel, and errors that name a cause and a remedy instead of relaying a stack trace
Optional transcripts, written beside the file as plain text or subtitles

description.p: Downloading is done by yt-dlp, which Magpie does not bundle: it is installed through your package manager and stays current with the rest of your system, because a pinned copy of a web scraper goes stale in weeks. Transcribing is done by whisper.cpp, which Magpie does build and include, because no distribution packages it and it has nothing to go stale against.
First release. A rewrite of an Electron application of the same purpose, in Rust with GTK 4 and libadwaita.
